description: Lists all channels in a Slack team.

cursor.description: Paginate through collections of data by setting cursor to a next_cursor value.

exclude_archived.description: Set to true to exclude archived channels. Default: false.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (max: 1000). Default: 100.

team_id.description: Encoded team id to list channels in (required if org token is used).

types.description: Mix and match channel types: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im. Default: public_channel.
